bio: David Carl Crowley (; born May 14, 1986) is an American politician who is the governor-elect of Wisconsin. A member of the Democratic Party, he is the first African American to be elected governor of Wisconsin. When sworn in, Crowley will also be the youngest governor in the United States at 40 years old.
offices: Member of the Wisconsin State Assembly (2017–2020)

items.q: The County Board approved the increase in July 2023, raising the county sales tax from 0.5% to 0.9%, and Crowley signed it the following month.
